description: See the shape a box plot hides. Violin, half violin, split violin, raincloud and ridgeline plots for Power BI, with density estimates you can state and defend. Free, and never blocked Five shapes: violin, half violin, split violin (two Split By levels share one violin), raincloud (density, box and every observation) and ridgeline. Density done properly: Scott, Silverman or R's default bandwidth, a smoothness control, trim to the data range, equal-area, equal-width or n-scaled violins. Inside the violin: a box, quartile lines, the points or nothing; whisker rules and all quartile definitions from Excel / DAX to Tukey. Reference lines: mean, median and up to four percentiles, for all data or per group. Sorting, minimum group size, horizontal layout, large-data input (Value as column + Count), a smart caption, a methods footnote, four themes, keyboard navigation, high contrast, English and Czech. Readers without a licence always see the free chart: no watermark, no broken report. Premium: compare and prove (per-user licence) Significance between groups or split halves: Welch t or Mann-Whitney U, Holm or Bonferroni, ANOVA or Kruskal-Wallis, brackets or letters. Advanced density: six kernels, a fixed bandwidth, bounded support by reflection. Confidence intervals, weights, spec limits (typed or from measures) with Cp to Cpm, small multiples.
